title: Late Report Penalties, Late Payment Interest and Abatement Requests on Employer Tax Accounts
content:
**Rule 1 — once per quarter.** On an account in the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, a late report penalty is assessed once per quarter. A quarter that already carries a late report penalty on the account receives no second one.

**Rule 2 — interest.** Contributions and reimbursement bills unpaid after their due date carry interest at the class's monthly rate on the unpaid balance of the quarter, for each month or part of a month of lateness. Interest is never charged on penalty or interest. Governmental reimbursing employers are not charged interest.

- The **unpaid balance of the quarter** is the contributions or reimbursement billed for the quarter less the payments and credits applied to that component of the quarter, never below zero, measured to the end of the accrual month.
- Each month's interest is the monthly rate multiplied by that unpaid balance, rounded to the cent.

**Rule 3 — abatement window.** A penalty abatement is granted only when it is requested no later than the abatement window after the penalty assessment date. The window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the penalty assessment date, and a request on the last day is in time. The assessment date is the entry date of that penalty in the account's balance history.

**Rule 4 — no abatement of interest.** Interest is never abated.

## Former clauses

The following clauses are **no longer in force** and have been superseded by the current basis:

- "A report filed after its due date carries a late report penalty of the larger of the flat penalty and the wage share of the quarter's total wages, capped at the maximum."
- The clause under which a late report penalty was abated in full, never in part, when the employer showed that no quarter in the abatement lookback before the late quarter had an original report filed after its due date, and requested abatement in time.

## Interest illustrations (hypothetical, monthly rate 0.01)

| Month of lateness | Unpaid contributions of the quarter at month end | Interest for the month |
|---|---|---|
| First | USD 2,000.00 | USD 20.00 |
| Second (after a USD 500.00 contribution payment) | USD 1,500.00 | USD 15.00 |

A quarter that also owes a USD 50.00 penalty draws no interest on that penalty; the interest above rests on the contributions only. A governmental reimbursing employer with the same unpaid bill is charged no interest.

## Abatement window, both sides (hypothetical, window of 30 calendar days)

| Penalty assessment date | Day 1 of the window | Last day of the window | Request on 2 April | Request on 3 April |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 March | 4 March | 2 April | In time | Too late |

superseded_clauses: A report filed after its due date carries a late report penalty of the larger of the flat penalty and the wage share of the quarter's total wages, capped at the maximum.
A late report penalty is abated in full, never in part, when the employer shows that taxacct_msr_prior_late_reports is zero and requests abatement in time.
